prediction.sql: WITH ClientCardInfo AS (SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id, cd.type AS card_type, cd.issued, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', cd.issued) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_card_issue FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN card AS cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE cd.issued = '1994-03-03'), ClientAccountInfo AS (SELECT cci.client_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans, AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM ClientCardInfo AS cci LEFT JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = cci.client_id LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY cci.client_id), ClientDistrictInfo AS (SELECT cci.client_id, dt.A2 AS district_name, dt.A3 AS region, dt.A11 AS avg_salary FROM ClientCardInfo AS cci JOIN district AS dt ON dt.district_id = cci.district_id) SELECT cci.client_id, cci.gender, cci.birth_date, cci.card_type, cci.age_at_card_issue, cai.account_count, cai.loan_count, cai.active_loans, cai.avg_loan_amount, cdi.district_name, cdi.region, cdi.avg_salary, CASE WHEN cai.loan_count > 0 AND cci.age_at_card_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN cai.loan_count > 0 AND cci.age_at_card_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS borrower_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cci.gender ORDER BY cci.age_at_card_issue ASC) AS age_rank_by_gender FROM ClientCardInfo AS cci JOIN ClientAccountInfo AS cai ON cai.client_id = cci.client_id JOIN ClientDistrictInfo AS cdi ON cdi.client_id = cci.client_id ORDER BY cci.gender, age_rank_by_gender
